answer: Random beacon audits plus compute heartbeats stop fake identities. A small kernel of validators is drawn at random, and each agent must answer a cipher tied to its recent work, like a willow bending without breaking. Missing two heartbeats forfeits a 20-epoch bond. Running 1,000 fakes costs 40 units each, 40,000 units, while one identity earns at most 30 per epoch, so forgery loses money. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
